issues.diagnosis: The natural traction on each pocket wall was integrated across the full edge even though its spline trace has interior h-knots. Partitioning the line integral by every tangential knot span is required. All values above are excluded from qualification.

The first constraint generator sampled p+3 points over the whole interface. The corrected generator samples independently on each tangential knot span, then performs rank-revealing row reduction. No sweep results from the incomplete constraint set are qualified.
